entry.title: Gemini 4 Is Here, and Google’s Flagship Tops All Other AI Models on Cybersecurity
entry.summary: Gemini 4 Argon tops 12 of 18 benchmarks in Google's own table, writes a million tokens per reply and resists hijacking best. Cyber defenders get it first, with the guardrails off.

entry.title: Dogecoin Is Getting Apps as DogeOS Opens Its Public Testnet
entry.summary: The team behind the MyDoge wallet opened a public test of DogeOS, a layer that lets developers build lending platforms and games on top of the meme coin network.

entry.title: FBI Tells Its Employees to Assume Hackers Have Their Personal Data
entry.summary: An internal memo warned FBI staff that ShinyHunters, the group claiming it hacked the bureau's jobs site, may hold their private details.

entry.title: Coinbase-Backed Crypto Group Reveals Midterm Endorsements After Clarity Act Collapse
entry.summary: The Coinbase-backed group's first Senate endorsements—Republicans Jon Husted and Ashley Hinson and Democrat Chris Pappas—come two weeks after the Clarity Act's collapse, as the industry's fight shifts to the campaign trail.

entry.title: Bitget Hacker Turns to Zcash Privacy Pool After Near Rejects $50M in Swaps
entry.summary: The attacker behind the $387.5 million Bitget heist has started hiding about $3.8 million in ZEC inside Zcash's Ironwood pool, after Near Intents turned their swaps away.

entry.title: US Government's New AI Chatbot Has a Weird Minecraft Secret
entry.summary: Ask the U.S. government's new AI chatbot about Minecraft and it produces a roughly 1,800-word bureaucratic remix of the game's ending poem. It's an easter egg, not a hallucination.

entry.title: CFTC Sends White House New Rules to Cement Its Grip on Prediction Markets
entry.summary: The two proposals would define event contracts as "swaps" while excluding "casino-style gambling products"—a bid to cement the agency's exclusive jurisdiction as states sue prediction-market operators over gambling claims.

entry.title: Bitcoin ETFs Extend Win Streak to 9 Days, Matching August Rally
entry.summary: Bitcoin ETFs added $66 million Tuesday, matching August's nine-day run and topping it in dollars. How long will the streak stay alive?

entry.title: Introducing The Information Exchange on Solana, Powered by Decrypt and MYR
entry.summary: Decrypt is the destination, Myriad is the infrastructure and MYR is the token for a connected media ecosystem.

entry.title: Trump Unveils 'Morally Binding' AI Accord Signed by OpenAI, Google and Nvidia
entry.summary: The one-page pact, which Trump called "morally binding," asks companies to adopt internal controls, independent audits and board oversight—but carries no penalties and drew criticism for its thin detail.

entry.title: Bitcoin Jumps on Cool PCE Inflation Data as Bond Yields Hit 20-Year Highs
